commands:
set -euo pipefail
REPO=/Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomaps/work
MAIN_SHA=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
WORK_SHA=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
TAG=pre-photomap-audit-20260913
BRANCH=work/photomap-straighten-20260912
cd "$REPO"
git fetch origin main "$BRANCH" --tags
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$MAIN_SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse origin/$BRANCH)" = "$WORK_SHA"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
if git show-ref --verify --quiet "refs/tags/$TAG" || git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "tag already exists: $TAG"; exit 1; fi
git merge-base --is-ancestor "$MAIN_SHA" "$WORK_SHA"
git tag -a "$TAG" "$MAIN_SHA" -m 'Rollback point before audited PhotoMap merge on 2026-09-13'
git push origin "refs/tags/$TAG"
git push origin "$WORK_SHA:refs/heads/main"
git fetch origin main --tags
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$WORK_SHA"
test "$(git rev-parse "$TAG^{commit}")" = "$MAIN_SHA"
echo TAG=$TAG
echo TAG_SHA=$(git rev-parse "$TAG^{commit}")
echo MAIN_SHA=$(git rev-parse origin/main)

set -euo pipefail
WORK_SHA=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'set -euo pipefail; cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; test "$(git branch --show-current)" = main; git fetch origin main --tags; git pull --ff-only origin main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f; ./scripts/serverctl.sh restart; ./scripts/serverctl.sh status; ./scripts/serverctl.sh tunnel-status; echo ---LISTEN---; ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep :8000; echo ---TUNNEL_INGRESS---; sudo -n grep -E "hostname:|service:" /etc/cloudflared/config.yml 2>/dev/null || true; echo DEPLOYED_SHA=$(git rev-parse HEAD)'

set -euo pipefail
PI=192.168.0.23
printf 'pi_loopback_health='
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@$PI 'curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health'
echo
printf 'pi_lan_health='
if curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://$PI:8000/health; then echo; else echo UNREACHABLE; fi
printf 'public_health='
curl -fsS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 https://photomap.pl/health
echo
printf 'public_home='
curl -fsS -o /tmp/photomap-public-index-130.html -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 15 https://photomap.pl/
echo
PI_ASSETS=$(ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@$PI 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; grep -oE "assets/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.(js|css)" frontend/dist/index.html | sort -u | tr "\n" " "')
PUBLIC_ASSETS=$(grep -oE 'assets/[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.(js|css)' /tmp/photomap-public-index-130.html | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')
echo PI_INDEX_ASSETS=$PI_ASSETS
echo PUBLIC_INDEX_ASSETS=$PUBLIC_ASSETS
test "$PI_ASSETS" = "$PUBLIC_ASSETS"
rm -f /tmp/photomap-public-index-130.html
echo PUBLIC_MATCHES_PI_BUILD=yes

set -euo pipefail
cd /Users/michal/agent-workspace/repos/photomaps/work
git fetch origin main work/photomap-straighten-20260912 --tags
test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = 578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
test "$(git rev-parse origin/work/photomap-straighten-20260912)" = 578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
test "$(git rev-parse pre-photomap-audit-20260913^{commit})" = dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
ssh -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=10 michal@192.168.0.23 'cd /home/michal/src/PhotoMaps; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8000/health >/dev/null'
echo verified_main=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
echo rollback_tag=pre-photomap-audit-20260913
echo rollback_sha=dcd99f07faf9e159a1b6b3f0b76ccff1e9db8ce1
echo pi_deployed_sha=578281bf750d7c86792ba4d6ccde505a7678c01f
